sources.title: Transparent storage and same-score/different-errors calculations
sources.details: In the T.4-shaped untied one-layer fixture, seven Linear matrices contain20736 weights. FP32 weights total33632*4=134528 bytes. Retained float entries are12896*4=51584 bytes; per-output-channel scale entries552*4=2208 bytes. Four-bit codes require20736/2=10368 bytes, so total64160. Eight-bit codes20736 bytes plus same retention/scales yield74528. These are per-state-entry logical bytes; do not claim unique shared-storage bytes or runtime memory. Separately two correct-indicator vectors [1,0] and [0,1] each sum to1 yet disagree on both questions, proving an equal aggregate accuracy need not mean equal per-item decisions.
